maddeler.e: بَرِيطَانِيّ or بِرِيطَانِيّ • (barīṭāniyy or biriṭāniyy) m (plural بَرِيطَانِيُّون (barīṭāniyyūn) or بِرِيطَانِيُّون (biriṭāniyyūn), feminine بَرِيطَانِيَّة (barīṭāniyya) or بِرِيطَانِيَّة (biriṭāniyya))
maddeler.t: For adjective sense 3, most likely referring to Jordan being formerly ruled by Britain.

maddeler.e: بَرِيطَانِيّ • (barīṭāniyy) (feminine بَرِيطَانِيَّة (barīṭāniyya), masculine plural بَرِيطَانِيُّون (barīṭāniyyūn), feminine plural بَرِيطَانِيَّات (barīṭāniyyāt))
maddeler.t: For adjective sense 3, most likely referring to Jordan being formerly ruled by Britain.
g: Jordanian, commonly used by Palestinians in response to the slur بَلْجِيكِيّ (baljīkiyy) employed by Jordanians.
